biggest_catch: Your FULL direct deposit must land at HCU every month for a full year, and if you close the account within the first 12 months the $300 is clawed back — this is a 12-month commitment, not a quick flip.
catches: You will receive your $300 bonus once Holyoke Credit Union receives your direct deposit; the direct deposit must be received within 60 days of account opening.
HCU must receive your full direct deposit during each monthly qualification cycle for a full year — not a one-time switch.
At least six (6) debit card purchases must clear and post within the first 60 days, OR you must spend $1,000 on an HCU VISA Platinum Credit Card within three months of it being issued.
You must enroll in online banking and receive eStatements.
Existing HCU checking account holders are excluded.
If you close the account within the first 12 months, your checking account will be charged $300 (clawback).

Membership eligibility is live or work in Hampden, Hampshire, Berkshire, Franklin, or Worcester County, MA, or Hartford County, CT per the current official About Us page (holyokecu.com/about-us) — a 2024 by-law amendment expanded the field from the old Hampden/Hampshire-only rule.
Bank bonuses are generally reported as interest income; expect tax reporting.
No stated promo end date — the offer could be changed or withdrawn without notice.

Set up your direct deposit to HCU so it is received within 60 days of opening, and keep your full direct deposit landing at HCU every monthly statement cycle for a full year.
Make at least six debit card purchases that clear and post within the first 60 days (or spend $1,000 on an HCU VISA Platinum Credit Card within three months of issuance).

The $300 bonus is credited once HCU receives the qualifying direct deposit; do not close the account within 12 months or the $300 is charged back.
